parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1: Use the iterative process correctly at least once, obtaining a value and substituting it back. A1: Final answer 8.03. A1: Show sufficient iterations to at least 4 decimal places to justify 8.03 to 2 decimal places, or a sign change in $(8.025,8.035)$. Printed examples include $7,8.4555,7.8846,8.0849,8.0115,8.0380,8.0283,8.0318$; $8,8.0421,8.0268,8.0324$; $9,7.7172,8.1490,7.9887,8.0463,8.0253,8.0329$. Total 3.
